name: Olaparib (mCRPC with HRR/BRCA mutation)

source.textbook: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.

institution.provenance: ONCQIS grounded Standard Protocol (experimental, owner/device test only; not clinically activated)

biomarkers.HRR: deleterious or suspected-deleterious germline or somatic homologous-recombination-repair (HRR) gene mutation required
biomarkers.BRCA: category 1 recommendation for BRCA-mutated (BRCA1/BRCA2) disease; preferred if docetaxel not yet received
biomarkers.note: Olaparib is a PARP inhibitor active in HRR-mutated disease via synthetic lethality; it is not effective without an HRR mutation. HRR genes considered for olaparib per the source: BRCA1, BRCA2, ATM, BARD1, BRIP1, CDK12, CHEK1, CHEK2, FANCL, PALB2, RAD51B, RAD51C, RAD51D, RAD54L. Somatic tumor and germline assays (or plasma ctDNA if biopsy not feasible) identify eligible patients. Per Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Prostate Cancer, Discussion (Olaparib, PROfound).

supportiveCare: biomarker gate: confirm an HRR (including BRCA1/BRCA2) mutation by a validated germline/somatic assay, or plasma ctDNA if a metastatic biopsy is not feasible, before starting (Discussion, prostate line ~7663).
continue ADT to maintain castrate testosterone below 50 ng/dL (PROS-G).
cycles null: continue until progression or unacceptable toxicity.
monitor complete blood counts and hepatic/renal function; transfusion support and dose reductions may be needed for anemia (Discussion, prostate line ~7665).
monitoring: CBC monthly (anemia, thrombocytopenia; rare risk of MDS/AML)
PSA and serum testosterone (confirm castrate level)
thromboembolic events and pneumonitis (rare but serious)

doseModificationRules.condition: grade 3 or higher anemia or other hematologic toxicity
doseModificationRules.text: Hold olaparib per labeling; transfuse as needed; resume at a reduced dose after recovery; obtain clinical review. Discontinue if MDS/AML is confirmed.

drugs.name: Olaparib
drugs.notes: Source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN) Prostate v6.2026 Discussion, prostate lines 7611 and 7657. Olaparib 300 mg PO TWICE daily (two 150 mg tablets twice daily) continuously (represented as days 1 to 28 of a 28-day cycle). Requires an HRR/BRCA mutation (biomarker gate).

provenance.locator: Discussion, prostate line 7611 (PROfound: olaparib 300 mg twice daily); prostate line 7657 (FDA approved olaparib 300 mg twice daily, May 2020)
